proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Proxy Access
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board enable shareholders, without group-size limits, to aggregate shares equal to 3% held continuously for 3 years to nominate directors via proxy access.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding proxy access.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Annual Reporting on Anti-Harassment and Discrimination Efforts
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual public report quantifying effectiveness of efforts to prevent harassment and discrimination against employees, including settlements, complaint resolution times and pending complaints.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding annual reporting on anti-harassment and discrimination efforts.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Annual Reporting on Board Diversity
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report on policies and practices to ensure the Board attains racial and gender representation better aligned with customer and regional demographics.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding annual reporting on board diversity.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Reporting on Employee Arbitration
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on the impact of mandatory employee arbitration on brand, employees, harassment and discrimination in the workplace.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reporting on employee arbitration.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Reporting on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests evaluation and report on whether Tesla's lobbying and policy influence align with the Paris Agreement's 1.5 degree goal and plans to mitigate misalignment.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reporting on lobbying.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Adoption of a Freedom of Association and Collective Bargaining Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests adoption and public disclosure of a policy respecting freedom of association and collective bargaining, aligned with ILO principles, with due diligence.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding Adoption of a freedom of association and collective bargaining policy.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Additional Reporting on Child Labor
proposals.topic_summary: Requests public report on whether battery mineral sourcing policies will eradicate child labor from the battery supply chain by 2025.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding additional reporting on child labor.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Additional Reporting on Water Risk
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board assess and report on ongoing water risk exposure and policies to reduce it, from facility siting to climate-related water supply reductions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding additional reporting on water risk.
